mistakes.text: The fastest sequence shows in slow motion at the end.
mistakes.normalized: the fastest sequence shows in slow motion at the end
mistakes.feedback_sk: Akciu niekto ukazuje, sama sa neukazuje, preto Passive: „is shown“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Akci někdo ukazuje, sama se neukazuje, proto Passive: „is shown“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The sequence doesn't show itself, so use the Passive: “is shown”.

mistakes.text: The fastest sequence is showed in slow motion at the end.
mistakes.normalized: the fastest sequence is showed in slow motion at the end
mistakes.feedback_sk: Past participle slovesa „show“ je „shown“, preto „is shown“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Past participle slovesa „show“ je „shown“, proto „is shown“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The past participle of “show” is “shown”, so say “is shown”.

mistakes.text: The fastest sequence was shown in slow motion at the end.
mistakes.normalized: the fastest sequence was shown in slow motion at the end
mistakes.feedback_sk: Opisuje sa, ako video prebieha teraz, preto „is shown“, nie „was shown“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Popisuje se, jak video probíhá teď, proto „is shown“, ne „was shown“.
mistakes.feedback_en: It describes how the video goes now, so use “is shown”, not “was shown”.

mistakes.text: They show the fastest sequence in slow motion at the end.
mistakes.normalized: they show the fastest sequence in slow motion at the end
mistakes.feedback_sk: Cvičenie precvičuje Passive: podmetom je akcia, teda „the fastest sequence is shown“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Cvičení procvičuje Passive: podmětem je akce, tedy „the fastest sequence is shown“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises the Passive: “the fastest sequence is shown”.

mistakes.text: The fastest sequence is shown in slow motion on the end.
mistakes.normalized: the fastest sequence is shown in slow motion on the end
mistakes.kind: on instead of at the end
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Na konci“ je po anglicky „at the end“, nie „on the end“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Na konci“ je anglicky „at the end“, ne „on the end“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Use “at the end”, not “on the end”.

source_issues: Slovak “akcia” / Czech “akce” mean “action”, the English reference says “sequence”; both are accepted.
